_comment: PAPER SPECIFICATION Table 2, via engineering spec Algorithm 14.11.
These fixtures validate the Effect Retention implementation against the paper's own
arithmetic BEFORE any model is invoked. Spec rule 18 calls this the cheapest
correctness gate available, and spec 32.4 makes a failure here an escalation trigger
rather than a bug to grind through: either the paper's arithmetic or ours is wrong.
Tolerance is 0.15 percentage points, not exact equality, because the pi-mono Hermes
cell computes to 27.9 against a printed 27.8 (spec 6.12 rounding note).
